name: Grunt
prompt: Create a neutral character-reference portrait of Grunt, the fictional krogan character depicted in the two official Mass Effect costume guides. One character only, entirely visible from head crest to toes, standing calmly with relaxed empty hands, turned three quarters toward the right side of the image. Follow the reference face, broad krogan proportions, orange and gold facial skin, gray-brown crest, and pale gray armor with its small blue lights. Preserve the exact visible armor shapes and equipment details from the guides. Soft even studio illumination, realistic high-resolution game-character rendering. Leave generous empty margins above, below and to each side, with the complete figure occupying about eighty percent of the image height. Transparent alpha background. No scene, ground plane, caption, frame, weapon, action or visual effects.
